title: Subset-sum formula for intersection tails
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The weighted sum over subsets $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ whose intersection with $U$ has size at least $k$ equals $\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}\mathbf{1}_{\{k\le |S|\}}\mathbf{1}_{\{S\subseteq U\}}\delta^{|S|}(1-\delta)^{|U\setminus S|}$, where $\mathbf{1}$ denotes the indicator, with value $1$ when its condition holds and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $U$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
